name: How Fast Does Gold React to NFP and Does It Persist Intraday?
description: Intraday event study: gold futures 1-minute reaction around NFP release at 8:30 AM ET. Strong NFP (>200K change) vs weak (<100K). Measures the initial spike, 1-hour digestion, and full-day persistence. Companion to daily gc_nfp_reaction_research.
source:
# =============================================================================
# HOW FAST DOES GOLD REACT TO NFP AND DOES IT PERSIST INTRADAY?
# =============================================================================
# NFP releases at 8:30 AM ET on first Friday of month.
# Regimes: Strong (>200K change) vs Weak (<100K change)
# Chart 1: Avg return across 3 time windows (spike → digestion → persistence)
# Chart 2: Cumulative immediate returns (does the spike compound?)
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1Min bars) ===
src = study_assets()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT ===
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, i_offset=0)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
open_price = cont.o

# === NFP RELEASE DATE DETECTION (via economic_calendar) ===
nfp_cal = economic_calendar(source=CalendarSource.FRED, release_id=50)
is_nfp_day = nfp_cal.is_released

# === NFP VALUES (still from economic_indicators) ===
nfp_data = economic_indicators(series_id="PAYEMS")
nfp_value = ffill(nfp_data.result)
bar_idx = index()

# === NFP CHANGE & REGIME CLASSIFICATION ===
had_nfp = is_valid(nfp_data.result)
prior_nfp_raw = valuewhen(occurrence=1)(had_nfp, nfp_data.result)
nfp_change_raw = nfp_data.result - prior_nfp_raw
nfp_change = ffill(nfp_change_raw)

is_strong = is_nfp_day and is_valid(nfp_change) and (nfp_change > 200.0)
is_weak = is_nfp_day and is_valid(nfp_change) and (nfp_change < 100.0)

# === SESSION WINDOWS ===

# Immediate: 08:30-08:31 (first 1 min spike)
w_imm = session_window(session=Session(start='08:30', end='08:31', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# 1hr Post: 08:30-09:30 (full hour after release)
w_1hr = session_window(session=Session(start='08:30', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# Full Day: 08:30-16:00 (release through near-close)
w_full = session_window(session=Session(start='08:30', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# === WINDOW RETURNS ===
r_imm = ((w_imm.close - w_imm.open) / w_imm.open) if w_imm.closed else 0
r_1hr = ((w_1hr.close - w_1hr.open) / w_1hr.open) if w_1hr.closed else 0
r_full = ((w_full.close - w_full.open) / w_full.open) if w_full.closed else 0

# === ALIGNED SERIES FOR XY_BARS ===
# All latched to w_full.closed so they fire on the same bar
imm_ret_latched = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_imm.closed, r_imm)
hr_ret_latched = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_1hr.closed, r_1hr)

# Strong aligned
strong_bar_imm = where(w_full.closed and is_strong, imm_ret_latched)
strong_bar_1hr = where(w_full.closed and is_strong, hr_ret_latched)
strong_bar_full = where(w_full.closed and is_strong, r_full)

# Weak aligned
weak_bar_imm = where(w_full.closed and is_weak, imm_ret_latched)
weak_bar_1hr = where(w_full.closed and is_weak, hr_ret_latched)
weak_bar_full = where(w_full.closed and is_weak, r_full)

# === COUNTERS ===
strong_count = where(w_1hr.closed and is_strong, 1.0)
weak_count = where(w_1hr.closed and is_weak, 1.0)

# === CUMULATIVE EVENT RETURNS ===
strong_imm_raw = r_imm if (w_imm.closed and is_strong) else 0.0
weak_imm_raw = r_imm if (w_imm.closed and is_weak) else 0.0
strong_imm_daily = strong_imm_raw if is_valid(strong_imm_raw) else 0.0
weak_imm_daily = weak_imm_raw if is_valid(weak_imm_raw) else 0.0
cum_strong_imm = cumulative()(strong_imm_daily)
cum_weak_imm = cumulative()(weak_imm_daily)

# === EVENT MARKER HELPERS ===
strong_nfp_chg = where(w_1hr.closed and is_strong, nfp_change)
strong_em_imm = where(w_1hr.closed and is_strong, imm_ret_latched)
strong_em_1hr = where(w_1hr.closed and is_strong, r_1hr)
strong_em_full = where(w_full.closed and is_strong, r_full)
weak_nfp_chg = where(w_1hr.closed and is_weak, nfp_change)
weak_em_imm = where(w_1hr.closed and is_weak, imm_ret_latched)
weak_em_1hr = where(w_1hr.closed and is_weak, r_1hr)
weak_em_full = where(w_full.closed and is_weak, r_full)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Cards: event counts ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='NFP Intraday Events',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['NFP Intraday Events'],
        col_headers=['Strong NFP Events (>200K)', 'Weak NFP Events (<100K)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='NFP Intraday'
)
(strong_count, weak_count)

# --- Chart 1: Return by Window (Spike → Digestion → Persistence) ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    title='Strong NFP Hits Gold Fast; Does the Weak NFP Lift Persist?',
    category='NFP Intraday',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Strong: 1min Spike', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Strong: 1hr', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Strong: Full Day', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Weak: 1min Spike', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Weak: 1hr', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Weak: Full Day', color=Color.Gray)
    ])
)(strong_bar_imm, strong_bar_1hr, strong_bar_full, weak_bar_imm, weak_bar_1hr, weak_bar_full)

# --- Chart 2: Cumulative Immediate Returns ---
xy_lines(
    title='Does the 1-Minute NFP Spike Compound Across Events?',
    category='NFP Intraday',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Strong NFP (>200K)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Weak NFP (<100K)', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ])
)(bar_idx, cum_strong_imm, cum_weak_imm)

# --- Event Markers (diagnostic) ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Strong NFP Events (>200K)',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='NFP Change (K)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Imm 1min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='1hr Post Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Full Day Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_strong, strong_nfp_chg, strong_em_imm, strong_em_1hr, strong_em_full)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Weak NFP Events (<100K)',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='NFP Change (K)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Imm 1min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='1hr Post Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Full Day Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_weak, weak_nfp_chg, weak_em_imm, weak_em_1hr, weak_em_full)
